pack.topic: Evaluating Cross-Subsidization & Spatial Efficiency in Coimbatore Real Estate
pack.source_script_insight: The Mumbai slum rehabilitation source illustrates how vertical density and cross-subsidization unlock immense value from constrained urban land, allowing high-margin commercial/luxury sales to fund essential public rehousing.
pack.coimbatore_angle: Teaching Coimbatore property investors how to evaluate urban redevelopment and high-density mixed-use land models in core commercial pockets like Gandhipuram, Ukkadam, and Town Hall using cross-subsidization principles.
pack.visual_strategy: The visuals strictly avoid residential sales cliches. Instead, they feature real density metrics: architectural site density blueprints, macro financial allocation ledgers, high-density vertical construction shots, aerial spatial footprint comparisons, and real Coimbatore street-level density visuals.
pack.core_takeaway: Cross-subsidization and vertical spatial efficiency maximize land yield in high-density urban corridors.

pack.gemini_video_prompt:
Production Prompt for Gemini Video Generation:

### A. MANDATORY OUTPUT FORMAT LOCK
- Exact Duration: 10.0 seconds
- Aspect Ratio: Native Portrait 9:16 vertical composition only.
- Target Platform: Mobile social video feeds targeting Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu.
- Client/Brand: OliveTree Investors.

### B. REALISM LOCK
- 100% Ultra-photorealistic real-world footage filmed in or accurately matching Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu.
- Crisp, natural afternoon sunlight, authentic tropical sky exposure, natural airborne dust, realistic concrete textures, asphalt sheen, realistic vegetation movement.
- Absolutely zero CGI, zero 3D architectural visualization renders, zero cartoon graphics, zero unrealistically glossy surfaces, zero plastic textures.

### C. SOURCE SUBJECT LOCK
- Subject: Urban Land Monetization & Cross-Subsidization Mechanism.
- Core Principles: 1. Vertical density frees up prime ground footprint. 2. Premium space sales cross-subsidize base-tier development or infrastructure. 3. Enables high-density financial feasibility in constrained urban cores.
- Application Layer: Coimbatore urban core spatial evaluation (Gandhipuram, Ukkadam, Town Hall corridor dynamics).

### D. SUBJECT-SPECIFIC VISUAL STRATEGY
- Focus exclusively on urban spatial density physical evidence: land maps, elevation density blueprints, raw structural concrete frameworks, ground footprint clearings, financial allocation ledgers, and busy Coimbatore street scene real footage.
- FORBIDDEN DEFAULT STORY: Do not show an empty residential plot, generic house elevation, family key handover, worker holding brick, or standard villa montage.

### E. CAMERA + IMAGE QUALITY
- Handheld real camera movement, stable drone framing, macro documentary depth of field.
- Native vertical framing (9:16), balanced dynamic range, realistic shadows, natural color balance suited to South Indian ambient lighting.

### F. EXACT 7-SHOT PLAN (Total 10.0 Seconds)

1. Shot 1 (0.0s - 1.4s)
- Location: Site office in urban Coimbatore.
- Visual: Close-up macro view looking down at a field tablet displaying a color-coded urban density map of core Coimbatore streets.
- Camera: Top-down static macro shot with gentle hand micro-shake.
- Lighting: Natural daylight coming through an office window.
- Text Overlay: "Land Density Model"
- Voiceover Tamil: "நகர்ப்புற நிலத்தின் முழு மதிப்பையும் உயர்த்த"

2. Shot 2 (1.4s - 2.8s)
- Location: Architect workspace desk.
- Visual: Focus on a physical paper blueprint detailing a split high-density multi-storey architectural elevation.
- Camera: Slow upward tilt from the legend section to the structural height diagram.
- Lighting: Warm ambient indoor lighting with clean shadows.
- Text Overlay: "Cross-Subsidization"
- Voiceover Tamil: "குறுக்கு-மானிய மாதிரி திட்டம் உதவுகிறது."

3. Shot 3 (2.8s - 4.2s)
- Location: Active modern commercial construction site in Coimbatore.
- Visual: Low-angle perspective looking up at concrete columns and floor plates of a multi-storey high-density build.
- Camera: Static low-angle upward tilt.
- Lighting: Direct clear afternoon sunlight with strong natural geometric shadows.
- Text Overlay: "Vertical Density"
- Voiceover Tamil: "அடர்த்தியான இடங்களில் செங்குத்து கட்டுமானம்"

4. Shot 4 (4.2s - 5.6s)
- Location: High-density urban parcel along a main Coimbatore road.
- Visual: High-angle drone perspective showing how vertical massing leaves open surrounding ground footprint and access roads.
- Camera: Slow vertical descent, 90-degree downward angle.
- Lighting: Natural daylight with realistic atmosphere and subtle haze.
- Text Overlay: "Freed Ground Footprint"
- Voiceover Tamil: "தரை பரப்பை மிச்சப்படுத்துகிறது."

5. Shot 5 (5.6s - 7.0s)
- Location: Financial office desk setup.
- Visual: Close-up hand shot holding a pen over a financial evaluation printout showing capital allocation columns labeled in INR.
- Camera: Macro focus on line items with organic finger tap on the paper.
- Lighting: Natural indoor studio daylight.
- Text Overlay: "Financial Feasibility"
- Voiceover Tamil: "உயர்தர விற்பனை மூலம்"

6. Shot 6 (7.0s - 8.4s)
- Location: Urban commercial street in Coimbatore (e.g., Gandhipuram commercial stretch).
- Visual: Street-level documentary view of modern multi-storey buildings lining a clean asphalt road with local traffic movement.
- Camera: Eye-level smooth lateral pan.
- Lighting: Bright overcast daylight with authentic environment reflections.
- Text Overlay: "Urban Unlocking"
- Voiceover Tamil: "அடிப்படை வசதிகள் சாத்தியமாகின்றன."

7. Shot 7 (8.4s - 10.0s)
- Location: Elevated panoramic perspective of Coimbatore urban skyline.
- Visual: Real view over dense modern urban roofscape and green tree pockets under natural sky with subtle brand overlay.
- Camera: Very slow forward push.
- Lighting: Late afternoon sun glow with rich depth.
- Text Overlay: "OliveTree Investors"
- Voiceover Tamil: "கோவை நகர்ப்புற முதலீட்டின் இந்த மாதிரியை புரிந்துகொள்ளுங்கள்!"

### G. MOTION-GRAPHICS LIMIT
- Minimal graphic overlays only (simple white typography, clean transparent dark background backing, 1-3 words maximum).
- No 3D floating arrows, animated icons, cartoon money symbols, or glowing laser lines.

### H. FINAL REAL SCENE
- Ends on a real, high-quality cityscape shot of Coimbatore (Shot 7) with a small, elegant 'OliveTree Investors' brand overlay.
- No standalone animated logo bumper or black title end card.

### I. NEGATIVE PROMPT / FIXED RULES
- DO NOT generate 3D architectural renders, toon/anime graphics, game-engine graphics, plastic surfaces, or hyper-saturated fake skies.
- DO NOT generate residential key handovers, generic happy families, plot sales boards, or generic house construction montages.
- NO horizontal landscape videos cropped into portrait canvas; NO black side bars or blurred video margins.
- NO exaggerated camera fly-throughs, 360-degree spins, fisheye distortions, speed ramps, or whip pans.
- NO fake landmarks, non-Indian road vehicles, or duplicated crowd assets.
